step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify Nodes: Visual diagram contains Source DB (OnPremDC/external), AWS Glue, RedShift, S3, DynamoDB, SageMaker, Lambda, API Gateway, and a mobile device representing driver/operating applications (UserConsumerMobile).
2. Identify Edges: Data flows from Source DB to AWS Glue, which then splits to RedShift, S3, and DynamoDB. An arrow leads from S3 up to RedShift (Redshift Spectrum). A bidirectional-style connection exists between RedShift and SageMaker. For the end-user request flow, the mobile application connects to API Gateway, which forwards requests to Lambda, which calls SageMaker endpoint for geocoding predictions.
